items.name: crm-hygiene-agent
items.title: CRM Hygiene Agent
items.description: Scheduled CRM hygiene via Connect that proposes dedupe, normalize, and enrich batches for human approval before any write.
items.author: TommyBez

overview: CRM Hygiene Agent is an eve agent that connects to one HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive account you already own. On each cron tick it reads contacts through Vercel Connect, drafts a dedupe, normalize, and enrich batch, and waits for you to approve before any CRM write.

You interact with it through environment variables and Slack or email. Set a Connect UID for the CRM you use, pick Slack Connect, Resend, or both, and trigger crm-hygiene-scan. The agent previews every digest and only delivers when confirmSend is true. CRM writes stay behind apply_hygiene_writes.

It is useful when you want scheduled cleanup without silent merges. Duplicate emails become a reviewable dedupe row. Name and phone formatting become normalize rows. Empty company or phone fields become enrich rows that copy from a sibling on the same domain. The append-only audit log records proposed, delivered, approved, written, and refused.
howItWorks: On the crm-hygiene-scan schedule (cron from CRM_HYGIENE_CRON, default 08:00 UTC), the agent loads the crm-hygiene skill.
It calls load_crm_config and stops when a HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive Connect UID is missing, or when neither Slack nor email delivery is configured.
scan_crm_records mints a Vercel Connect token and lists contacts. That tool is read-only and never merges or patches a record.
propose_hygiene_batch drafts dedupe, normalize, and enrich work, writes the batch into the append-only audit log, and returns written false.

If the batch has proposals, the agent calls preview_hygiene_digest, then deliver_hygiene_digest with confirmSend true. That tool pauses for Eve approval before the Slack Connect channel or Resend. The cron path does not call apply_hygiene_writes.
Four evals cover the schedule path, digest preview, writes that require approval, and a run that must not apply without confirmWrite.

useCases.title: Duplicate emails waiting for a human
useCases.body: Two HubSpot contacts share ava@example.com. propose_hygiene_batch adds a dedupe row. Slack gets the draft batch. apply_hygiene_writes runs only after you approve with confirmWrite true.

useCases.title: Name and phone cleanup
useCases.body: A Salesforce contact has firstName ava and a ten-digit phone. The normalize proposal title-cases the name and prefixes plus on the phone. Nothing is patched until apply_hygiene_writes is approved.

useCases.title: Fill empty company from a sibling
useCases.body: A Pipedrive person on example.com has no company. Another person on that domain lists Acme. The enrich row copies Acme into the empty field and never overwrites a filled company.

useCases.title: Monday cron, Slack review
useCases.body: Set CRM_HYGIENE_CRON to weekday mornings and Slack Connect. Operators get one draft batch in the Eve Slack channel. The cron path stops after deliver_hygiene_digest. Writes wait for chat plus approval.

requirements.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
requirements.body: A model credential for the deployment, either a Vercel AI Gateway API key or AI Gateway OIDC, so the agent can call zai/glm-5.2.

requirements.name: CRM_PROVIDER
requirements.body: Optional force of hubspot, salesforce, or pipedrive. When empty, the first complete Connect UID wins.

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_CRON
requirements.body: 5-field cron for crm-hygiene-scan. Defaults to 0 8 * * * (08:00 UTC on Vercel).

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_MAX_RECORDS
requirements.body: Maximum contacts to read per scan. Defaults to 100.

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_AUDIT_PATH
requirements.body: Append-only JSONL audit log. Defaults to .data/crm-hygiene-audit.jsonl. Stores identifiers, proposal kinds, and changed field names only. Use a durable volume if the app filesystem is ephemeral.

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS
requirements.body: Days to keep audit rows. Defaults to 90. propose_hygiene_batch purges older rows.

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_DEFAULT_PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE
requirements.body: Optional country calling code, digits only, used before adding + to a national phone. Leave empty to leave non-E.164 numbers unchanged.

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_SLACK_CONNECT_UID
requirements.body: Optional Vercel Connect Slack connector UID for the Eve Slack channel. Leave empty to skip Slack delivery.

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID
requirements.body: Optional Slack channel id for the draft batch. Leave empty to skip Slack delivery.

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_HUBSPOT_CONNECT_UID
requirements.body: Vercel Connect HubSpot connector UID from vercel connect create hubspot. Mints crm.objects.contacts.read, crm.objects.contacts.write, and crm.objects.companies.read. Writes still require apply_hygiene_writes after Eve approval.

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_SALESFORCE_CONNECT_UID
requirements.body: Vercel Connect Salesforce connector UID from vercel connect create salesforce. Mints api and refresh_token.

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_SALESFORCE_INSTANCE_URL
requirements.body: HTTPS Salesforce instance URL required when the provider is salesforce.

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_PIPEDRIVE_CONNECT_UID
requirements.body: Vercel Connect Pipedrive connector UID from vercel connect create pipedrive. Mints contacts:read and contacts:full.

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_PIPEDRIVE_COMPANY_DOMAIN
requirements.body: Optional Pipedrive company domain. The runtime talks to api.pipedrive.com with the Connect token.

requirements.name: RESEND_API_KEY
requirements.body: Resend API key used by deliver_hygiene_digest when email recipients are configured. The idempotency key is forwarded to Resend.

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_DIGEST_FROM
requirements.body: Verified Resend sender for the HTML digest. Recipients and sender cannot be overridden through tool input.

requirements.name: CRM_HYGIENE_DIGEST_TO
requirements.body: Comma-separated recipient addresses. Optional CRM_HYGIENE_DIGEST_SUBJECT defaults to CRM hygiene batch.

faqs.question: How do I install and run a scan?
faqs.answer: Install with npx shadcn@latest add @evex/crm-hygiene-agent, copy .env.example, set one CRM Connect UID plus Slack or Resend, then POST to /eve/v1/dev/schedules/crm-hygiene-scan while iterating.

faqs.question: Does the cron path write to the CRM?
faqs.answer: No. crm-hygiene-scan reads, proposes, and may deliver a digest after approval. apply_hygiene_writes is the only write path and is not called on cron. confirmWrite must be true after a later Eve approval.

faqs.question: Is Slack required?
faqs.answer: No. CRM_HYGIENE_SLACK_CONNECT_UID and CRM_HYGIENE_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID are optional. When both are set, deliver_hygiene_digest posts the draft batch through the Eve Slack channel. That ping is not a CRM write.

faqs.question: How do I approve a cleanup batch?
faqs.answer: Review the Slack or email digest, then call apply_hygiene_writes with the proposed batch and confirmWrite true. The tool always pauses for Eve approval. Without that grant the CRM client refuses POST, PATCH, PUT, and DELETE.

faqs.question: What if two contacts share an email?
faqs.answer: propose_hygiene_batch adds a dedupe row that keeps the fuller record as primary. The merge stays staged until you approve apply_hygiene_writes. There is no auto-merge and no silent overwrite.
